description: Animated, grainy gradient backgrounds and mesh gradients for React. WebGL2, zero dependencies.
rules: Import from 'hazeglow' in React and from 'hazeglow/core' without React.
Always pass a config through parseConfig before rendering it.
Render <Hazeglow config={config} /> absolutely positioned inside a relatively positioned container, behind the content.
Prefer a config designed at https://hazeglow.dev/generator over inventing colors, and never put a CSS gradient on top of the canvas.
Colors can be hex, oklch() or var(--token) with a fallback (hazeglow 0.3.0 or newer).
Keep live gradients to a few per page; browsers allow about 16 WebGL canvases, so use a still image elsewhere.
